title: Bitcoin open interest falls 30%, setting up bullish recovery: Analyst
summary: Bitcoin derivatives open interest fell 30% from October highs as deleveraging purged excess leverage, historically signaling market bottoms and recovery.

title: Bitcoin ‘groove’ to return despite gold, Nasdaq spotlight: Arthur Hayes
summary: Bitcoin should be able to steal some “juice” back from gold and the Nasdaq in 2026, with several catalysts supporting the idea of US dollar liquidity expansion.

title: Blockchain firm eyes $200M in tokenized water projects across Asia
summary: Some crypto executives predict the tokenized real-world asset market will grow significantly in 2026, fueled by adoption in emerging economies.

title: Ex-NYC mayor Eric Adams denies moving money out of controversial token
summary: Despite the backlash, a spokesperson for Adams said he remains committed to funding education programs and supporting scholarships for underserved students through the token.

title: Crypto Fear & Greed index flips to ‘greed’ for first time since October
summary: Crypto traders and investors can use sentiment indexes to gauge the market and inform their decisions on whether conditions favor buying or selling.

title: Russia plans limited crypto access for retail investors, lawmaker says
summary: A top Russian lawmaker says crypto “will be a common occurrence” in the country, with plans for a bill to deregulate the market for retail use.

title: Crypto industry split over CLARITY Act after Coinbase breaks ranks
summary: Crypto executives are divided over the market structure bill in its current form, with some arguing it needs major work, while others appear more supportive.

title: Solana Mobile to airdrop 1.8B SKR tokens to users, 141M to devs
summary: Solana Seeker owners and mobile app builders will receive billions of Seeker (SKR) tokens next week. The airdrop represents 20% of the total token supply.

title: US Senate Banking cancels Thursday crypto bill markup amid negotiations
summary: Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott says further negotiations to garner bipartisan support for a key crypto-regulating bill are needed before it can advance.

title: Senator Lummis says delay likely for market structure bill: Bloomberg
summary: The debate over DeFi and stablecoin reward provisions in the CLARITY Act is at risk of holding the bill back as banking and crypto stakeholders push competing agendas.
